# Genesis Plus GX Core Provenance

The Android libretro binaries used by the built-in MD/Genesis runtime were
downloaded from the official Libretro buildbot on 2026-08-03:

```text
https://buildbot.libretro.com/nightly/android/latest/{ABI}/genesis_plus_gx_libretro_android.so.zip
```

They are packaged under the Android native-library name
`libgenesis_plus_gx_libretro_android.so`.
